name: DataShield: Privacy Engineering & GDPR/LGPD Compliance
description: Step into the role of Chief Data Protection Officer at FinNova Digital, a rapidly growing LATAM fintech. Over five rounds spanning 18 months, navigate privacy impact assessments, cross-border data transfers, a 2-million-record breach, consent management redesign, and a comprehensive privacy governance framework. Balance compliance, customer trust, privacy culture, regulatory risk, and budget while complying with GDPR, LGPD, and LATAM privacy regimes.
